subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which open candidate should own the pathless `read` image media repair for this issue and its related shared-media reports?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but multiple open candidates propose different repair shapes and the trusted local-media boundary needs maintainer review before merge.

options.title: Use the current shared-media PR
options.body: Review, repair, and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 if its proof and security-boundary concerns clear.

options.title: Revive the start-args fallback
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 or the fork PR if maintainers prefer resolving media from original tool args instead of persisting inbound media.

options.title: Queue a replacement only after closing candidates
options.body: Close the stale/conflicting candidates and promote one new narrow replacement only if both existing fix shapes are rejected.

recommendation.title: Use the current shared-media PR
recommendation.body: Review, repair, and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 if its proof and security-boundary concerns clear.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the shared pending tool-media reply delivery path and is the best routing candidate for choosing the repair shape.
